flows.clientTitle: Client flow (Building Manager or Delegated Technician)
flows.clientIntro: Manage tenders on behalf of your clients or condominiums with a structured and fully traceable process.

clientSteps.create: Create the tender by entering title, description, estimated budget range and uploading the professional BOQ.
clientSteps.collect: For 15 days companies can participate, but bids remain private until the deadline (no early visibility).
clientSteps.view: At the deadline you see all bids at the same time and can download the quotes to discuss them with the client or in the assembly.
clientSteps.awardAdmin: If you are a Building Manager you upload the assembly minutes assigning the work to the chosen company.
clientSteps.awardTech: If you are a Delegated Technician you upload the quote signed and accepted by the client.

clientBenefits.free: Free service for Building Managers and Technicians.

contractorSteps.signup: Free registration and completion of your company profile.
contractorSteps.browse: Browse tenders with information on area, type of works and budget range.
contractorSteps.credits: Participation via credits: the cost to unlock a tender depends on its budget range.
contractorSteps.offer: Fill in the BOQ online by entering unit prices and upload your signed quote.
contractorSteps.win: If you are awarded, a percentage fee is requested on the contract value; only after payment the award is regularised and the clearance for signing is issued.

sections.heading: Who we are
sections.body: Appalto Smart is a digital platform created to help building managers, delegated technicians, and construction companies manage private tender processes with greater clarity, speed, and traceability.

sections.heading: What we do
sections.body: The platform supports tender publication, contractor access, document management, bid submission, comparison of offers, and communication between participating parties.

sections.heading: Our standard
sections.body: We aim to provide a professional, transparent, and organized environment. Users are responsible for checking the accuracy of their own company data, tender documents, bids, and uploaded files before submitting them.

sections.heading: Payments and credits
sections.body: Contractor participation may require credits or platform fees. Purchased credits, access fees, and participation fees are non-refundable once purchased or used, except where a refund is required by applicable law.

sections.heading: Information we collect
sections.body: We may collect account details, company information, contact data, tender documents, bid documents, usage records, transaction records, and technical information needed to operate and secure the platform.

sections.heading: How information is used
sections.body: Information is used to create and manage accounts, publish and manage tenders, process bids, provide notifications, support customer requests, maintain platform security, and improve service quality.

sections.heading: Sharing and visibility
sections.body: Tender and bid information may be visible to the relevant authorized users involved in a tender process. We do not sell personal data. Data may be shared with service providers only when needed for hosting, payments, analytics, support, compliance, or security.

sections.heading: Retention and security
sections.body: We retain information for as long as needed to provide the service, comply with legal obligations, resolve disputes, and maintain business records. We use reasonable technical and organizational measures to protect platform data.

sections.heading: User responsibility
sections.body: Users must not upload confidential, unlawful, or unnecessary personal information unless it is required for the tender process. Users should ensure they have the right to share all uploaded documents and data.

sections.heading: Use of the platform
sections.body: By using Appalto Smart, users agree to provide accurate information, keep login credentials secure, use the platform lawfully, and avoid actions that may disrupt, misuse, or compromise the service.

sections.heading: Tender and bid responsibility
sections.body: Building managers, technicians, and contractors are responsible for the content, accuracy, completeness, and legality of tenders, bids, prices, documents, signatures, and communications submitted through the platform.

sections.heading: No guarantee of award or outcome
sections.body: Appalto Smart provides digital tools for managing tender workflows. We do not guarantee that a tender will receive bids, that a contractor will win a tender, or that any commercial agreement will be completed.

sections.heading: Non-refundable payments
sections.body: All credit purchases, tender unlocks, access fees, platform fees, and participation fees are final and non-refundable after purchase or use. Refunds are provided only where required by applicable law or where Appalto Smart confirms a billing error.

sections.heading: Service changes
sections.body: We may update, improve, limit, suspend, or discontinue parts of the platform when needed for maintenance, security, compliance, product development, or business reasons.

sections.heading: Limitation of liability
sections.body: To the maximum extent permitted by law, Appalto Smart is not liable for indirect losses, lost profits, missed business opportunities, user-submitted errors, third-party actions, or decisions made based on tender or bid information.
